kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننسكب (form VII)
# نَنْسَكِبُ (nansakibu) /nan.sa.ki.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْسَكَبَ (insakaba)
# نَنْسَكِبَ (nansakiba) /nan.sa.ki.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْسَكَبَ (insakaba)
# نَنْسَكِبْ (nansakib) /nan.sa.kib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْسَكَبَ (insakaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
